title: A missing page on a Space's own domain shows the website's own not-found, not Frequency's platform header

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-09: wildheart.frequencylocal.com/events landed on wildheart.academy/events and showed the Frequency header (Feed, Discover, Pricing)

detail:
A page the site does not declare 404s inside SitePage, and app/hosted had no not-found of its own, so the root not-found rendered Frequency's platform shell on the Space's domain. ADR-1723: a visitor on a website is never sent back to the main site. The 404 status is right (Wildheart has no /events page; its calendar is /calendar). Fix: app/hosted/[host]/not-found.tsx, no platform chrome, one link to the site's own home. Done when the file exists, reads no platform shell, and a dead path on a custom domain renders it.

Closed by #4708: app/hosted/[host]/not-found.tsx exists with no platform shell; the probe passes on main.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p="app/hosted/[host]/not-found.tsx";if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error("no site-own not-found: a dead page on a custom domain falls through to the platform shell");process.exit(1)}const s=fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(/site-shell|SiteShell/.test(s)){console.error("the site not-found wears the platform shell");process.exit(1)}'
